strings.lang.intro: Ol bikpela tokples i stap pinis. Kisim yu tokples bilong yu bilong pulap tarnslesen i no nidim intanet — ol dispesriksen, stori bilong ol na moa.
strings.lang.failed: Kisim i no wok. Lukim koneksen na traim gen.

strings.settings.location.cityNone: I no bin painim — lista i gat inap 5,300 bikpela taun, olsem na ol liklik taun i no stap.
strings.settings.location.cityNearest: Makim bikpela taun i klostu tru: insait long ~50 km skai i luk wankain.

strings.pro.freeCore: Bikpela hap bai stap fri oltaim — kamera, San, Mun na olgeta 7 planet. Pro i mekim bikpela lista i go bikpela liklik na i putim sampela liklik tul moa.
strings.pro.lifetimeDesc: Baim wanpela taim tasol. I no gat taim pinis — em bai i no inap pinis o kirap gen.
strings.pro.notRenewing: Bai i no kirap gen — pasin bilong go insait pinis long {date}
strings.settings.haptics.desc: Sek taim yu lokat long wanpela samting.
strings.settings.speech.desc: Ritim aut target na gait long ples — bilong yusim nating han na ol man i no ken lukim.
strings.settings.fov.desc: Senis liklik bai lain bilong gaden sta na rot bilong satelait i makim tru heven.

strings.sat.desc.iss: Bikpela haus insait long spes we man i stap. Wanpela lain astronot i stap insait oltaim, na em i raunim graun klostu olgeta 92 minit. Planti taim em i bikpela lait tru i wokabaut antap long skai long nait.
strings.sat.desc.css: Stesin spes bilong Sainis, i gat man i stap long en long 2021. Em i liklik moa long Stesin Spes bilong Olgeta Kantri, tasol long gutpela taim i wokabaut i lukim klostu wankain lait.
strings.sat.desc.hst: Glas lukluk longwe spes i go antap long 1990 i senisim save bilong yumi long bikpela spes. Em i kisim piksa bilong ol galaksi i stap longwe tumas na i helpim long makim hamas kwiktaim bikpela spes i kamap bikpela.
strings.sat.desc.acs3: Satelait bilong traim bilong NASA, i gat sail bilong san klostu 80 m², i wokim long pawa bilong lait bilong san tasol. Sail i lait i mekim em i lait long saiz bilong en.
strings.sat.desc.envisat: Satelait bilong Yurop bilong lukluk long graun, saiz bilong em i wankain long bas. Toktok wantaim em i lus long 2012, na kirap long dispela taim em i stap yet long raunim olsem wanpela bikpela hap bilong doti bilong spes.
strings.sat.desc.amos: Lain satelait bilong toktok bilong Israel. Ol i stap long hait klostu 36,000 km, olsem na ol i luk olsem i no muv long wanpela ples long skai. Yu no ken lukim ol wantaim ai tasol, tasol ap i soim ol long yu.
strings.sat.desc.eros: Satelait bilong Israel bilong kisim gutpela piksa, ImageSat i wokim, i go antap long 2022.
strings.sat.desc.venus: Satelait bilong painimaut bilong Israel-France i go antap long 2017, i kisim piksa bilong diwai na graun bilong wokim gaden long lukim senis bilong environmen.
strings.sat.desc.cat.weather: Satelait bilong weta i wokabaut antap long ol pol. Em i kisim piksa bilong klaut, bikwin, na hat, na save bilong em i helpim tingting bilong weta.
strings.sat.desc.cat.observation: Satelait i kisim piksa bilong antap graun — bus, taun, solwara, na ais — bilong lukim olsem ol i senis long taim.
strings.sat.desc.cat.science: Satelait ol i wokim bilong stadi long spes o graun. Sampela bilong ol i no wok moa, tasol ol i stap yet long raunim.
strings.sat.desc.cat.telescope: Glas lukluk longwe spes i lukim bikpela spes antap long win, we i kisim planti lait i kam long spes.
strings.sat.desc.cat.communication: Satelait i karim television, intanet, na kol long fon. Planti bilong ol i flai antap tumas, olsem na ai tasol i lukim sampela bilong ol.
strings.sat.desc.cat.starlink: Wanpela bilong planti tausen satelait Starlink bilong SpaceX, i givim intanet long spes. Ol i flai daun, olsem na isi long lukim, na sampela taim ol i wokabaut long bikpela laen, wanpela i bihainim narapela.
strings.sat.desc.cat.rocket: Antap hap bilong rokiet, i karim satelait long raunim bilong en na em yet i stap long dispela ples. Dispela samting i bikpela na planti taim i lait, olsem na isi liklik long lukim ol.
strings.identify.proMore: Pro i save makim tu wanwan sta, grup sta, na samting bilong spes i dip tru.
strings.moon.asSeen: I lin olsem yu lukim long ples bilong yu · {t}
strings.tonight.hint: Taim we wanwan samting i stap antap long skai tonait · tasim bilong makim kamera long en
